# R linear-model reference cases

`r_linear_reference.json` is generated by `tools/export_linear_model.R` using
`stats::predict.lm` on the saved selected model bundle. It contains the three
input features and two reference predictions for 49 training sites, 24 synthetic
category/count combinations and 6 missing/unseen-category cases. It contains no
coordinates or observed survey targets. Source identity and model version are
recorded alongside the cases.

Regenerate it only when deliberately exporting a reviewed model release. These
full-model predictions verify R/Python equivalence, not predictive performance.
See `docs/03_model_development/selected_model_integration.md` for the export command.
